lines.en: My whole body jerks forward.

lines.zh: 雨里我走得很急，脚下打滑。
lines.en: I hurry through the rain, feet slipping.
The splashes don't bother me.

lines.zh: 我低着身子，像要扑出去。
lines.en: I crouch low, as if about to spring.

lines.zh: 我的关节咔咔响，没个准。
lines.en: My joints crack out of rhythm.

lines.zh: 我沿着河岸跑，往人声去。
lines.en: I run the riverbank toward voices.
I shudder once, then keep going.
Water drips off me quickly.
I walk with my teeth gritted.
I circle a puddle.
The river's wide; my footing holds.
I sniff out a direction in the rain.
I can't stop; I keep twitching.
Rain fills my mouth; I don't cough.
I listen to the flowing water.
I lick my teeth. They're sharp.

lines.zh: 这具身体，五到七点血而已。
lines.en: This body holds five to seven points of life.
I run in water and on land alike.
I wait for the rain to thicken.
I lift my head and let rain hit my eyes.
When wind blows, my twitching worsens.
I have no patience.
I smell it: someone nearby.

lines.zh: 舌头收不住，总想伸出去。
lines.en: My tongue won't stay in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我试着站定，可身体不听话。
lines.en: I try to stand still, but my body won't obey.
I stare at the ripples on the water.

lines.zh: 我数着还剩几分钟天光。
lines.en: I count how much daylight is left.
When the sun rises, I'm finished.
You carry the smell of water. Good.

lines.zh: 我扑上去的时候，你别跑太快。
lines.en: Don't run too fast when I leap.
Your legs look biteable.
I'm not shivering from fear; I can't stop.
One step back and I lunge closer.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，让我牙痒。
lines.en: Your scent makes my teeth itch.
Fire in your hand? I don't like it.
The rain is heavy. Just how I like it.

lines.zh: 我够不到的东西，我也能扑过去。
lines.en: What I can't reach, I'll still leap at.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我可不觉得好笑。
lines.en: What are you smiling at? I don't find it funny.
My mouth twitches. Don't mind it.
You smell of medicine.

lines.zh: 我咬上一口，你就难治了。
lines.en: One bite and you'll be hard to cure.
You stand firm. I'll charge anyway.
I jerk and give half a step.
This body was thin to begin with.
I bite down on my own wrist.
Blood mixes with the water.
The wound throbs and my twitching worsens.
You hit my ribs.
I sprawl, then rise again.
I never mind this kind of pain.
I let out a small cry.
You're faster, but I'm not afraid.
You hold it up; I stare.

lines.zh: 我这嗓子，什么都咽不下。
lines.en: My throat can't swallow anything.
My claw reaches out and curls back.

lines.zh: 这点吃的，不够我咬一口。
lines.en: That isn't one mouthful.
I sniff it, my teeth chattering.
You back away with it; I follow.
Cooked food turns my stomach.
Drop it and maybe I'll take it.
Give it to me and I still won't thank you.
Don't put that hand too close.
You bump me and I spring at you.
My body is all sharp bone.
I charge you and fall over myself.
I can't stand steady, and neither will you.

lines.zh: 碰到我，湿冷会钻进你衣服。
lines.en: Touch me and the wet chill gets into your clothes.
You step out of reach; I won't chase far.
I press my whole weight on you.
My twitching makes my hits miss.
Don't push me. I bite.
One touch and I'll remember you.
Another one shivers in the rain too.
We don't close in; we only sniff.
It's thinner than I am.
We head for the village together.

lines.zh: 同族之间，咬一口也无妨。
lines.en: Between our kind, a bite is no offense.
It lunges; I dodge.
By the water, company is rare.
We run abreast, kicking spray.
It leaves first; I don't hold it back.
Next rain, perhaps we'll meet again.
I take what's on the ground in my teeth.
I grab a handful and drop half.
The pearl is slippery; I bite down on it.
I pin it under my chest.
Twitching, I pick it up slowly.
This isn't food.
I sniff it. Not much interest.
Whatever falls, I bite first.
I duck my head and gulp it down.
I keep what I find.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，我锁住了。
lines.en: I've locked onto your smell.

lines.zh: 我扑过去，不管够不够得着。
lines.en: I spring, whether or not you're in reach.
Your back is turned. What luck.
My jaws close, and it's done.
I'm faster in water.

lines.zh: 你退到岸边，就没有水了。
lines.en: Back to the bank and you lose the water.
I twitch, but I can still catch you.
You're wounded. I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我锁定了，从现在起你跑不掉。
lines.en: Locked on. From now you can't escape.
I'll bite your calf.

lines.zh: 你举火把，我绕到另一边。
lines.en: You raise a torch; I go round the other side.

lines.zh: 这一刻我等得牙齿发酸。
lines.en: I've waited for this till my teeth ache.
The more you run, the farther I leap.

lines.zh: 我在水面上跳，追得很快。
lines.en: I skip across the water, gaining fast.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在泥里，藏不住。
lines.en: Your prints in the mud give you away.
Out of reach, and still I jump.
You glanced back. Don't.
I chase along the river; the water helps me.

lines.zh: 你的光越来越远，我不怕黑。
lines.en: Your light recedes; I don't fear the dark.
I twitch, and I keep following.
You stepped in water. I smelled it.
Waiting for me to stop? I won't.
I'm coming from your flank.
Your breath grows shorter.
I round the rock on a shortcut.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，咬住你的手臂。
lines.en: I leap and bite your arm.
One bite and the wound will burn.
I rake your face with filthy nails.
I bring you down with my whole body.

lines.zh: 水溅起来，我的牙也到了。
lines.en: Water splashes, and so do my teeth.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡了手，挡不了牙。
lines.en: Your shield stops my hands, not my teeth.

lines.zh: 这一口，你回家也治不好。
lines.en: This bite won't heal at home.

lines.zh: 我撞你的胸口，把我自己撞翻。
lines.en: I ram your chest and knock myself over too.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿咬碎了你的护腕。
lines.en: My teeth crush your bracer.
You back away; I leap again.

lines.zh: 雨落下来，我从河里出来。
lines.en: Rain falls and I climb out of the river.
The water stirs and I come ashore.
Someone has called me.

lines.zh: 我抖着站直，身上还滴水。
lines.en: I straighten up shaking, still dripping.
The light dims. Just the time.
I surface from beneath the water.
My teeth show first.
This area smells good.
I land and sprawl for a moment.
The bank is slick; I nearly fall.
The rain covers my steps.
I'm here. Don't expect reason.
I'm still covered in river mud.
Soaked so long, my bones feel soft.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的皮就卷起来。
lines.en: Fire makes my skin curl back.

lines.zh: 摔下来，我的骨头差点散了。
lines.en: The fall nearly scatters my bones.

lines.zh: 水灌进肺，我反而更清醒。
lines.en: Water in my lungs only wakes me up.
The blast drives me into the mud.

lines.zh: 箭穿进我的腿，我照样扑。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my leg; I lunge anyway.

lines.zh: 光落下来，我全身僵了一瞬。
lines.en: Light falls and I stiffen for an instant.
Hungry enough that even my teeth shake.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我差点烧起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I nearly catch fire.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，雨也追不上我。
lines.en: I fall, and even the rain can't follow.
